decisions.reason: A standard perfect binder is closely related to an established print-finishing wholesale portfolio, so an experienced German wholesaler is likely to retain it unless sales proved clearly weak, and the missing later web archives are too inconclusive to imply exit.

The fully automatic perfect binder still fits the firm's existing knowledge base, but its higher complexity and narrower customer segment raise the chance of discontinuation somewhat if early market feedback did not justify the support effort.

A booklet maker for inline and nearline use is adjacent to the same customer and service capabilities, so the firm likely keeps it while learning from demand, though product-specific sales uncertainty makes a later withdrawal plausible.
